name: blaze-mail
description: Production-grade Email builder, MIME formatter, and SMTP/API client package for BlazeLang

1.0.0.readme:
# blaze-mail > Version 1.0.0 — Production-grade Email Builder, MIME Formatter & Client for BlazeLang Created by **ShortCodeGuy Studio** for BlazeLang 2.9.0. --- ## Features - **Email Validation**: RFC-5322 compliant email syntax validation. - **Template Engine**: Dynamic string template rendering with custom placeholder tokens (`[name]`, `[link]`). - **Rich Message Builder**: Fluent builder for `setFrom`, `addTo`, `addCc`, `addBcc`, `setSubject`, `setText`, `setHtml`, `setHeader`, `setPriority`, and `attach`. - **RFC-2822 / MIME Generation**: Generates multipart MIME payloads with boundary separation, custom headers, and Base64 attachment encodings. - **Client & Provider Integration**: Dispatch simulation and JSON payload generation for email service providers (SendGrid, Mailgun, Resend, SMTP). - **Custom Developer CLI**: Built-in developer CLI command `blz mail [validate|preview]` declared via `blaze.json`. --- ## Package Files - `index.blz`: Main package implementation exporting the `BlazeMail` API. - `cli.blz`: Developer CLI command runner for `blz mail`. - `example.blz`: Comprehensive end-to-end usage script demonstrating validation, templating, MIME formatting, and dispatch. - `blaze.json`: Package manifest and custom command declarations. - `package.json`: Compatibility manifest. - `blaze-mail.blzp`: Compiled zero-disk RAM package bundle. --- ## Usage Example ```blz Import BlazeMail from "blaze-mail" // 1. Validate email var isValid = BlazeMail.validate("alex@blazelang.org") // 2. Render Template var template = BlazeMail.createTemplate("Hello [name], Welcome to [platform]!") var body = template.render([ ["name", "Alex"], ["platform", "BlazeLang Hub"] ]) // 3. Build Email var message = BlazeMail.createMessage() message.setFrom("noreply@blazelang.org", "Blaze Team") message.addTo("developer@example.com") message.setSubject("Welcome to BlazeLang") message.setText(body) message.setHtml("

Welcome!

") message.attach("guide.txt", "text/plain", "SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=") // 4. Generate RFC-2822 MIME var rawMime = message.toMime() Show(rawMime) // 5. Send Email var client = BlazeMail.createClient("smtp.blazelang.org", 587, "admin@blazelang.org") var result = client.send(message) Show("Success: " + result["success"]) ```
